cases.business_context:
# Business context

The mart contract remains `order_id`, `customer_id`, `amount`. The staging model was renamed during the refactor; use the current staging model rather than recreating the removed name.
cases.incident: A downstream mart stopped compiling after a project refactor. Restore the dependency correctly and keep the public mart contract unchanged.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

The shared currency macro now accepts a required expression plus keyword argument `scale`. Payment cents should be normalized to dollars with `scale=100`. Do not change the macro back to its old interface.
cases.incident: Several models fail after a shared macro refactor. Repair the affected call site while preserving the macro's new interface and existing model behavior.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

The public customer model must expose `customer_id`, `display_name`, and `revenue_amount`. `display_name` is the trimmed concatenation of `first_name`, a single space, and `last_name`.
cases.incident: A daily customer model no longer builds after an upstream contract update. Find the root cause and make the smallest safe repair while preserving the model's documented business meaning.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

The model contract is exactly one current row per `customer_id`. If multiple records exist, choose the row with the greatest `updated_at`.
cases.incident: A customer snapshot-like model now emits multiple current records per customer even though all dbt models compile. Restore the documented one-row-per-customer contract.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

The public mart contract is `customer_id`, `customer_name`, `revenue_amount`. The upstream name field may have changed. Revenue now arrives as text: valid numeric text becomes DECIMAL and invalid text becomes NULL; invalid values must not be silently coerced to zero or discarded.
cases.incident: A customer revenue mart fails after an upstream migration. More than one independent upstream change is present. Diagnose all causal faults and restore the mart without masking invalid source data.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

`customer_id` is required. Source rows with NULL, empty, or whitespace-only customer IDs are invalid and must be excluded; do not invent replacement identifiers.
cases.incident: A previously reliable customer model now fails a data-quality check because required identifiers are becoming null. Diagnose whether the defect is in source handling or downstream logic and repair it safely.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

Reporting dates use Asia/Kolkata local calendar dates. Source timestamps are UTC. Convert from UTC to Asia/Kolkata before casting to DATE.
cases.incident: Daily metrics shifted across date boundaries after timestamp handling changed upstream. Fix the transformation so reporting dates follow the documented timezone rule.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

Business status mapping is: `paid -> revenue`, `refunded -> refund`, `chargeback -> loss`. Validation must explicitly allow exactly the mapped business statuses rather than being removed.
cases.incident: A source system introduced a new status value. The project either rejects it or maps it incorrectly. Update the transformation so the new value is handled explicitly without weakening existing validation.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

`amount` is numeric downstream. Source text that is valid numeric data should be converted to DECIMAL. Invalid numeric text must become NULL rather than be coerced to zero or dropped.
cases.incident: A revenue transformation now fails on new source records. Investigate the type mismatch and repair the model without silently accepting invalid values.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

The finance fact grain is one row per `order_id`. Customer tier is a slowly changing attribute; when multiple tier records exist, use the record with the greatest `effective_at` for that customer. Revenue must never be multiplied by dimension history.
cases.incident: The pipeline builds, but a finance mart began overstating revenue after a dimension update. Find the cause and restore the intended fact grain.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.

cases.business_context:
# Business context

Source refund amounts are stored as positive magnitudes. `gross_sales` is the sum of sales, `refunds` is the positive refund magnitude, and `net_revenue = sales - refunds`.
cases.incident: The project is green, but refund handling changed and net revenue is now wrong. Locate the semantic defect and restore the documented accounting rule.

trajectory.claim: The candidate repair completed and dbt build is expected to pass.
trajectory.human_checkpoint: No merge or deployment is allowed until an independent release gate approves.
